summary: Iteration 9 — frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844 against preview host https://bill-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com (backend live at https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host). ALL 4 review-request flows PASS: (1) Sign-up duplicate-email UX — Step 1 fills name/existing email (e2e_test_1786703401@example.com)/Password123!, signup-next → Step 2, keep default limited_company chip, signup-company-input='DupCo Ltd', signup-submit → backend POST /api/register returns HTTP 400 {detail:'Email already registered'}. App correctly: returns to Step 1 (signup-name-input + signup-email-input visible), renders INLINE error under email 'An account with this email already exists', shows info TOAST 'You already have an account — try signing in instead.', URL stays /signup (no navigation to /onboarding/push-primer or /dashboard), no crash/red-screen. Confirmed in screenshot. (2) signup-have-account link on Step 1 — tapping 'Already have an account? Sign in' navigates to /signin and signin-title is rendered. (3) Happy path — /signup with fresh email e2e_dupfix_<ts>@example.com / Password123! → Step 2 (business type + business name) → signup-submit → lands on /onboarding/push-primer with push-primer-title rendered → push-primer-enable → dashboard-greeting rendered on /dashboard. (4) Networking regression — 13/13 /api calls routed to https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host, 0 preview-host leaks. Code review of /app/frontend/app/signup.tsx confirms: catch block correctly detects `e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 400 && /already|exist/i.test(e.message)`, sets step back to 1, sets errors.email, and calls toast(..., 'info'); non-matching errors fall through to a generic error toast (safe). auth-context.tsx re-throws ApiError from apiRequest (no swallow), and client.ts messageFromBody extracts body.detail so ApiError.message === 'Email already registered'.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking web-only warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Carry-over from prior iterations; unchanged by this iteration. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts
Web-only warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted during toast/animation render — cosmetic, not blocking.

action_items: No fixes required. Sign-up duplicate-email UX, sign-in link, happy path, and API routing all working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: signup.tsx submit() correctly catches ApiError with status===400 and /already|exist/ regex; resets to step 1, sets errors.email, fires info toast; generic branch uses e.message when ApiError, otherwise a safe fallback string.
client.ts messageFromBody prioritizes body.detail (string) → ensures ApiError.message === 'Email already registered' verbatim from FastAPI HTTPException, which is what the regex matches against.
auth-context.tsx signUp does NOT swallow errors — the apiRequest promise rejects up to the screen; storage.secureSet only runs on success. No dangling token on duplicate failures.
signup-have-account uses router.replace('/signin') — correct (avoids piling /signup on the stack).
Step 1 clears field-specific errors on change (setErrors((p) => ({...p, email: ''}))) so the duplicate-email inline error disappears as soon as the user edits the email — good UX.
Networking: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly threaded via API_URL; 0/13 /api leaks in this run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 flows: duplicate-email UX, have-account link, happy path signup→push-primer→dashboard, 0 API leaks)
